launches.title: Lune AI - Better LLMs for code and technical tasks
launches.tagline: A replacement to standard LLMs for coding tasks - eliminate hallucinations with a marketplace of expert LLMs trained on hundreds of technical topics.
launches.body:
[ ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iPCixKBJiZI)

Hey everyone! We’re Sam and Josh, and we’re building a platform for better LLMs for code and technical tasks.

## **TLDR:**

[Lune AI](https://www.lune.dev/) is a platform to find and train Lunes, or expert LLMs on any technical topic for code. We outperform the accuracy of standalone foundational models by [37%](https://www.lune.dev/blog/lune-evaluation).

Here’s a [**demo**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zwokp23C3ek):

## **The Problem:**

LLMs **hallucinate** on material outside their training data, which often leads to inaccurate answers to technical questions related to code. Whether it’s working with a new library, or the ever changing nature of software documentation, every developer has **wasted time** on hallucinated LLM outputs.

## **Lune Web:**

On Lune Web, users can find a [marketplace](https://chat.lune.dev/explore) of community trained Lunes on **hundreds** of the most popular libraries and Github repositories for developers. In a concept similar to OpenAI’s GPT store, users that train popular Lunes receive monthly payouts in a **revenue share program**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85640&key=user_uploads/1758131/9b8e2428-b02e-4247-a5bc-f8746504e7f1)

When interacting with Lunes on the web, users can also **receive payouts** for leaving feedback on Lune performance and contributing their own expertise to specific Lunes. This direct community driven feedback loop continuously improves the accuracy of our models.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85640&key=user_uploads/1758131/0a27c84c-44d0-477a-a4db-3d3ccf8c6da1)

## **Lune API:**

In addition to Lune Web, we offer API access to our proprietary automatic context switching model, Tycho as well as all public Lunes. Tycho is our context switching model that **automatically determines** the right Lunes to retrieve information from given a user query, in order to provide the most accurate answer. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85640&key=user_uploads/1758131/0fb0ab51-5d7c-4578-8174-21d5e9563ff0)

Our API is hot swappable with OpenAI, which means our users can [integrate](https://docs.lune.dev/docs/external-integrations/cursor) Tycho into any IDE, tool, or client that **supports OpenAI compatible APIs** with a personal API key, such as Cursor, Continue, and other AI client SDKs. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85640&key=user_uploads/1758131/4de9c6f0-f8a8-4015-99ef-18034e454ede)

Project keys with our API can be used to easily integrate backend applications and workflows where **superior accuracy and minimized hallucinations** for technical topics are necessary. For example, generating compliable, front-end code with context from various pip packages or libraries.

## **About Us:**

We are brothers who have been working together our whole lives, starting out with Lego projects. We both dropped out of Harvard because we believed that there is a very near future where AI + Coding can lead to 10x better productivity for the world. We want to make that a reality.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85640&key=user_uploads/1758131/da7c5a23-106f-4f64-bf42-1dfa460be8ca)

## **Our Ask:**

If you code and you have experienced LLM hallucinations, hate reading through dense documentation and Github repos, give [Lune AI](https://www.lune.dev/) a try!

If you are building a product that uses LLMs for generating code or other technical tasks and want a hot-swappable, more accurate alternative, reach out to me at [sam@lune.dev](mailto:sam@lune.dev)

launches.title: Astrix: AI purchasing agents for healthcare providers
launches.tagline: Automated purchasing of the right healthcare supplies, at the right time.
launches.body:
Hi everyone, we are Abu and Tom, co-founders of [Astrix Health](https://www.astrix.health/)

# **TL;DR**

Astrix builds AI purchasing agents for healthcare providers.

Our agents automatically purchase the right products at the right time, helping eliminate the $25 billion in wasted spend on medical supplies annually in the US.

# **Why is this important?**

The US spends roughly $4.5 trillion per year on healthcare, with wasteful spending accounting for up to a quarter of that amount. On average, hospitals in the US waste at least $12 million each on medical supplies. Adding to the problem, nurses can spend anywhere between **20 minutes to one hour per shift** searching for medical supplies.

For clinics, this problem is even worse. Often, the same people responsible for treating patients are also in charge of purchasing supplies. They’re already stretched on time to care for patients, let alone shop around for the best deals.

While shadowing an imaging center, we observed a nurse doubling as an office manager, simultaneously managing inventory, searching for deals, placing orders, and treating patients. When we got home we started building.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85809&key=user_uploads/659147/266d9b6a-1150-42bb-9fd1-5a79f9640753)

# **Our solution**

Our product has three main functions:

1. **Analyze:** The agents comb through purchasing data (such as invoices) to identify high-spend areas and cost drivers.
2. **Search:** Deployed AI agents search for better deals, considering provider-specific arrangements like preferred vendor discounts, GPO contracts, rebates, and other incentives.
3. **Purchase:** Where appropriate, Astrix place orders when more cost-effective options are found, saving providers time and money.

In under three weeks, Astrix has started working with 10 healthcare clinics, **identifying an average 20% cost savings** across our first users’ recurring supply purchases. Our AI agents deliver immediate value, reducing expenses and freeing up providers to focus on patient care.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85809&key=user_uploads/659147/e7f5971c-af42-4f86-9f25-420e42710daf)

# **Why now?**

Until recently, it was impossible to efficiently scan numerous websites and compare the myriad factors influencing purchasing decisions—such as per-unit costs, availability, expiration dates, device sizes, shipping, and more—at scale to find the best deals. Automating ERP and website navigation for purchases or negotiating with vendors was also previously unfeasible.

Additionally, we're frustrated by the poor quality and outdated nature of the incumbent supply chain software and strongly believe providers deserve better. AI offers a unique opportunity to fundamentally rethink how healthcare professionals interact with computer systems.

# **Moving forward**

Purchasing is just the beginning. We aim to become the comprehensive optimization layer for hospital supply chains, integrating inventory, purchasing, and patient data to put procurement operations on autopilot—ultimately reducing that **$25 billion waste to zero.**

Healthcare professionals should never feel stressed about ordering or obtaining medical supplies, nor should patient care be delayed due to supply chain inefficiencies. That’s the problem we’re committed to solving.

# **The team**

Our team has extensive experience building AI/ML systems for major healthcare institutions. Abu and Tom, who met at Palantir, developed some of the first generative AI projects for the UK's National Health Service.

Abu led Palantir's medical and pharmaceutical distribution vertical in the US and its healthcare generative AI team in the UK. Previously, he managed data projects at Duke Health and MedStar Health across clinical science projects and hospital operations.

Tom has experience solving optimization problems with AI from his time as an Engineer at Palantir and his Maths degree from Oxford.

# **Our ask**

Email us at [founders@astrix.health](mailto:founders@astrix.health). We're seeking introductions to:

* Hospitals
* Private practices
* Ambulatory surgical centers

We'd be incredibly grateful for any connections. As a bonus, if they share their last month's purchasing data with us, we'll provide a detailed analysis of their potential cost and time savings.

launches.tagline: We help biotech companies design better proteins by making AI models controllable and predictable.
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We're [Nithin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nithin-parsan) and [John](https://www.linkedin.com/in/johnyang101), founders of Reticular.

**TL;DR:**

Reticular gives pharma companies precise control over protein AI models, enabling reliable drug discovery without millions in wasted experiments. We're unlocking encoded information in these models through foundational AI interpretability research, making steering as easy as prompting ChatGPT.

**The Team:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85439&key=user_uploads/684233/c914554d-0323-4701-8892-d9bf859a832c)

Nithin and John are huge AI + Bio nerds who:

* Met 7 years ago competing in International Biology and Neuroscience Olympiads and were roommates at MIT for 4 years
* Published ML/bio research in NeurIPS, Nature, and PLoS ONE

**The Challenge:**

Information in biology is incredibly scarce and expensive to validate. While protein AI models like AlphaFold have revolutionized drug discovery, they're still black boxes:

* Companies waste millions testing AI-generated designs and they can't easily control what these models output
* Limited data makes validation slow and expensive

**Our Approach:**

Instead of trial-and-error, we're leveraging mechanistic interpretability techniques that excel at extracting sparse knowledge from models even with scarce data. We’re demonstrating that the same advances from frontier AI labs in steering models like Claude are applicable to unlock protein language models.

For our design partners, we’re delivering:

* Direct steering of protein models towards desired properties
* Interpretable biological features backing every design
* Efficient exploration of combinatorially massive design spaces with limited data

**See It In Action:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85439&key=user_uploads/684233/3805bd5b-792f-4a8b-bd6c-cffec150612d)

We're steering Green Fluorescent Protein towards more fluorescent sequences by directly controlling the model's internal knowledge.

**Learn More** at [reticular.ai](http://reticular.ai), our proof-of-concept [blog post,](https://nithin-parsan.medium.com/two-neurons-is-all-you-need-a-case-study-on-interpretability-in-protein-models-5295ab9133cb) and at [demo.reticular.ai](http://demo.reticular.ai).

**We're Looking To Connect With:**

* Startups working with biological language models for design partnerships
* Pharma teams building generative discovery pipelines
* Researchers working on AI interpretability

Working with biological AI or have relevant connections? We'd love to chat! Schedule some time at [calendly.com/reticular](https://www.calendly.com/reticular) or **email us** at [contact@reticular.ai](mailto:founders@reticular.ai)

# **TL;DR**

ISSEN is an AI realtime voice language app that helps you become fluent in any language. Your on-demand voice tutor is personal to _you_, adapting lessons and chats to your skill level, particular interests, learning style, and goals. Try it at [issen.com](http://issen.com).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85733&key=user_uploads/2292308/ee13ea2a-72c1-430a-ba4a-12e2dff909bd)

# **The problem:**

Conversation is essential for learning a language, yet no app provides truly free-flowing dialogue. At best, current solutions have you respond to preset messages to evaluate your pronunciation and word choice.

The only effective solution for this is non-technological: a language tutor. Having a tutor can be awesome, but there are real downsides: these can be costly ([$20/hour on italki on average](https://www.glassdoor.com/Salary/italki-Salaries-E348674.htm)), difficult to schedule, and have a high upfront cost (finding a tutor you like often forces you to cycle through a few that you don’t).

# **The solution**

We set out to redefine what a language learning app can be—not by building on existing solutions, but by starting with the experience of a human tutor.

ISSEN is a true language tutor, accessible anytime from your computer or phone. Conversations can be as structured or open-ended as you like—dive into focused grammar lessons or have a casual chat about your day. Over time, you build a relationship with your AI tutor, which means that as they get to know you, they tailor conversations and lesson plans to your needs–but will never judge you when you make a mistake! Plus, our AI tutors are deeply multi-lingual, so if you are a Danish/Mandarin Chinese native looking to learn Gujarati, ISSEN is the app for you.

Our mission is to transform language learning by delivering the connection, effectiveness, and fun that, until now, only human teachers could offer.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7sftLFew6eM>

# **The team**

We’re Mariano and Anton, co-founders who met at Stanford and share a passion for language learning. Mariano is a former crypto engineer and VC at a16z, and has dedicated years to mastering Japanese. Anton, a native Spanish, English, and Italian speaker, spent seven years at Palantir kickstarting and building Palantir LATAM and leading infrastructure as Chief Architect of Infrastructure, Security, and Hosting.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85733&key=user_uploads/2292308/a8d89083-8164-46a6-9854-60ad8bae9245)

# **How you can help**

If you’re serious about improving your foreign language skills—or know someone who is—you can try the app now at [issen.com](http://issen.com). The web app is live (with iOS and Android versions coming soon). Just enter your email, explore the features, and share your feedback with us at [founders@issen.com](mailto:founders@issen.com).

name: CTGT
long_description:
CTGT is an applied AI research laboratory fundamentally solving the alignment and reliability bottleneck for enterprise AI.

For enterprises, especially highly regulated industries, deploying Generative AI is historically a compromise between capability and catastrophic risk. Standard enterprise approaches, such as RAG, fine-tuning, and prompt engineering, operate at the wrong abstraction layer. They are inherently probabilistic, carry massive engineering overhead, and fail to deliver the mathematical certainty required by the Fortune 500.

We focus on the science of representation engineering and have productized mechanistic interpretability. By opening the "black box" of neural networks, CTGT has developed a proprietary architecture that intervenes directly at the model's representation layer. We convert complex corporate SOPs, SEC/FINRA regulations, and strict editorial rulebooks into machine-readable "Policy as Code," enforcing deterministic constraints and defensible audit trails without requiring expensive model retraining.

The result is a step-function breakthrough in enterprise AI economics and capability. Our fundamental architecture allows organizations to run secure, self-hosted open-source models that mathematically match the reasoning and performance of frontier models. Benchmarks from our enterprise deployments demonstrate a 96.5% prevention of hallucinations, up to a 3.3× accuracy multiplier in complex domain-specific tasks, and an 80-90% reduction in human-in-the-loop manual review.

Backed by an $8M seed round from Gradient Ventures (Google), General Catalyst, and Y Combinator, CTGT is currently deployed with Fortune 500 companies, including Tier-1 financial institutions and global media conglomerates, giving them the deterministic control necessary to deploy enterprise AI with zero margin for error.
one_liner: The deterministic layer for frontier intelligence

launches.body:
We're building the future of trustworthy AI deployment. CTGT helps enterprises eliminate hallucinations and unwanted behavior in LLMs while dramatically accelerating time-to-production.

[Utilizing CTGT's Platform for Model Evaluation and Monitoring 🚀 - Watch Video](https://www.loom.com/share/7e4948fa0ccf4256b2f7036ee8d7baf4)

## **The Problem: “Black Box” of AI**

The status quo of deep learning involves throwing more compute at models with the expectation that they will achieve true intelligence. The questionable nature of this assumption aside, this will certainly lead to more complex models that we don’t meaningfully understand.

I’ve been obsessed with AI and its potential to change the world since I was a kid. In high school, I took apart old laptops to eke out just a bit more performance to train models, so I’m exceedingly aware how important access to and understanding AI is. (For more background, check out the great piece [TechCrunch did on us](https://techcrunch.com/2024/10/29/ctgt-aims-to-make-ai-models-safer/).)

Enterprise companies are sitting on powerful AI models but can't deploy them due to hallucinations and unpredictable behavior.

* Healthcare providers can't risk medical chatbots giving dangerous advice
* Financial firms need guarantees their AI won't recommend fraudulent investments
* Tech companies need AI that consistently aligns with their brand voice

## **Our Solution: Principled AI Development**

CTGT takes a fundamentally different approach. Rather than black-box approximations, we've developed breakthrough technology that understands [how neural networks actually learn](https://openreview.net/forum?id=8WiNDyXgj6). 

This allows us to:

* Automatically detect and eliminate hallucinations
* Train models 10x faster with 10x less compute
* Give enterprises foundational control over AI behavior

How it works:

Let’s imagine we ask an LLM about cooking food. 

_I started lunch by simmering water on the stove. I prepared dough for a homemade pizza dish. Using a knife, I sliced fresh tomatoes and cheese. I spread glue on the bread for tomorrow's breakfast. The dough rose in the oven. I brewed tea while stirring the soup with a spoon. A plate was set, and lunch was nearly complete. Every pot and utensil had its place._ 

We can determine, for example, that pizza and bread is part of the “food” concept in the model, along with other related things in the output.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WSDro9tEz_w> 

And we can determine that “glue” shouldn’t be part of this concept.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=skW5Z5CPr9o> 

Our technology ensures “glue” doesn’t appear in queries regarding food, reducing hallucinations by 80-90%.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sH8x9boOtF4> 

## **Real Results with Fortune 10 Companies**

We're already helping major enterprises deploy AI with confidence:

* Removed bias from facial recognition systems in one step
* Eliminated investment advice hallucinations for portfolio managers
* Enabled fraud detection LLMs with precise error identification

## **The Team**

Founded by UCSD researchers pushing the boundaries of AI:

* Cyril Gorlla (CEO): Recipient of the Endowed Chair's Fellowship at UCSD. His work on efficient AI training was invited for presentation at ICLR and his talk at Ai4 was the most attended in its track. He collaborated with Intel on ML telemetry deployed on 8M+ CPUs. He was named one of 12 “2022 Shining Stars” at UCSD and is an Ivory Bridges Fellow and Nordson Leadership Scholar. He was advised by ACM and Amazon Fellow Mikhail Belkin.
* Trevor (CTO): Deep learning researcher focused on high powered distributed ML systems under Hao Zhang, a student of Databricks Founder Ion Stoica, at UCSD.

## **Why Now**

Legacy companies and those without access to massive amounts of compute can greatly benefit from specialized, domain-specific AI. Current LLM interpretability methods are extremely inefficient, effectively rendering them inaccessible to the vast majority of companies. There’s a shift from large foundation models to those tailored to each company’s brand and applications. Our technology enables this future by making state-of-the-art AI accessible without massive compute resources.

name: Lingo.dev
long_description:
Lingo.dev is the localization engineering platform: the best way to translate with LLMs, measure translation quality, and proofread with native speakers.

Lingo.dev is built for teams accountable for quality in languages they can't read. Teams configure localization engines, stateful translation APIs that hold the glossary, brand voice, and per-locale model preferences, and every request retrieves that context at inference time through retrieval augmented localization. Every translation is scored before it goes live, scores and corrections tune the engine, and the localization team runs the localization infrastructure. Integrate through the API, CLI, CI/CD, or native integrations with the code repository and the CMS. 

Lingo.dev is the standard localization infrastructure for modern enterprise teams scaling into new markets – including Mistral, Solana, SoSafe, and Cal.com. Over 300M words processed, SOC 2 Type II compliant.
one_liner: The Localization Engineering Platform

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
Veronica and Max met eight years ago at work and have been building together since. Veronica came from data science, then AI. Max came from engineering, having led a DORA-elite frontend team at Typeform.

Between them they had shipped software at startups and enterprises and bootstrapped a SaaS with customers in over 100 countries. Localization broke the same way every time: the people accountable for the result could not read most of the languages they were accountable for. They approved work they could not check, and they found out it was wrong from a customer.

Every product on the market treated that as a workflow problem, so it sold coordination. It is a measurement problem. Lingo.dev was built around the instrument first, and the pipeline around the instrument.

question_answers.question: How did you decide to apply to Y Combinator? What was your experience applying, going through the batch, and fundraising at demo day?
question_answers.answer:
Our first serious customers arrived, Cal.com among them, and the question stopped being whether this works and became how far it goes. Localization is a global problem by definition. Every company that grows past one language has it, in every market it enters, permanently. A problem that shape deserves a lasting, durable company behind it rather than a good couple of years.

So we shot for the stars and applied to the best accelerators in the world. We ended up in conversations with several, and we chose Y Combinator.

No other program has a record like it. Stripe, Airbnb, DoorDash, and Coinbase all started there, and each one became the default infrastructure of an entire category, operating in nearly every market on earth. YC backs companies at the point where the idea still looks small and the market does not exist yet, and it does that more often, and more correctly, than anyone else. That is the standard it sets, and that is the company we wanted to keep.

The batch did what it is known for: sharper questions, faster iteration, and a peer group that tells you the truth early rather than politely later. We raised $4.2M from Y Combinator, Initialized Capital, and the founders of Supabase and Dependabot to scale the platform and meet the growing demand from international teams.

question_answers.question: How have you kept in touch with the YC community and continued to use YC resources & programs since the batch ended?
question_answers.answer:
We attend YC events and stay close to the private network between them.

We try to be genuinely useful. Founders ask about localization, going multilingual, and expanding internationally, and we take those conversations whenever there is a chance to help. The network works because founders treat it as something to contribute to, so that is how we use it.

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer:
Founded in December 2023, after winning an AI product competition at Cornell Tech in New York. Full-time from February 2024.

The first product translated software with AI on every commit. It worked, and it showed how small that problem is. The commit loop is roughly one percent of localization work, and it was already close to solved.

The inflection was the buyer. Localization managers and localization engineers carry accountability for quality in languages they cannot read, and the market treats that seat as an afterthought. The company was rebuilt around that seat, and the tool became a platform: localization engines, quality scoring, native integrations, and proofreading with native speakers.

Today over 300M words have been processed on the platform, for teams including Mistral, Solana, SoSafe, and Cal.com. Lingo.dev is SOC 2 Type II compliant and has raised $4.2M from Y Combinator, Initialized Capital, and the founders of Supabase and Dependabot to scale the platform and meet the growing demand from international teams.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
A company releases into thirty languages. The person accountable for those languages reads two.

Translation stopped being the constraint, it comes back in seconds, from an agency or straight from a model, and it gets cheaper every quarter. What nobody hands the accountable team is the number: which languages are good, which drifted, and what to fix first. Without it the team either trusts output it cannot read, or pays a person to read every string.

Lingo.dev is where that number comes from. Teams pick from the industry-standard metrics or define quality criteria in plain words, and every translation is scored before it goes live. Every low score carries its reason, traced to the model, the translation rule, or the missing glossary term. Corrections from native speakers tune the localization engine, so the edit rate falls over time.

It is a big problem because the accountability does not move. Software goes out in more languages every year, the people who answer for those languages still cannot read them, and the volume of text nobody has checked grows with every release.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
Translation quality becomes a measured quantity.

Today it is an opinion. Vendors assert it, buyers cannot check it, and nearly every quality number published in this industry arrives without a method behind it. When Lingo.dev succeeds, a team states what its Japanese was worth this quarter, what changed since last quarter, and what caused the change, the same way it states its uptime.

Downstream of that, a product goes live in every language it has customers in on the day it goes live in English, and the team that owns those languages proves the result instead of defending it.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84681&key=user_uploads/1992394/c62aca07-353c-49ad-a49e-b403d1b784e0)

**TL;DR**

[Lingo.dev](https://lingo.dev) is the localization engineering platform: the best way to translate with LLMs, measure translation quality, and proofread with native speakers.

It's built for teams accountable for quality in languages they can't read: a localization team, or the product, engineering, or marketing team that inherited localization without one. Every translation is scored before it goes live, and scores and corrections tune the localization engine.

**Speed stopped being the problem**

A release goes out in thirty languages, and the person accountable for it reads two.

Translation comes back fast now, from an agency or straight from a model, and it gets cheaper every quarter. The number nobody hands you is the quality one: which languages are good, which drifted, and what to fix first. Without it you are accountable for quality you can neither read nor repair.

**What Lingo.dev does**

* **Build your own localization engine.** A localization engine is a stateful translation API that holds your glossary, brand voice, and per-locale model preferences. Retrieval augmented localization sends that context to the LLM at inference time. Assign the highest-scoring model per language pair, with a fallback order, on your own LLM provider API key or through Lingo.dev without markup.
* **Measure translation quality in languages you can't read.** Pick from the industry-standard metrics, define your own quality criteria in plain words, bring the quality scorecard you have, or start from a template built for your content type. The criteria you define score translations from LLMs and from native speakers, and every low score comes with the reason, traced to the model, the translation rule, or the missing glossary term.
* **Integrate localization into the tools you already use.** Connect the code repository, the CMS, the help center, and the email provider through native integrations, and reach the same localization engine from the API, the CLI, and CI/CD. The localization team runs the localization infrastructure.
* **Proofread with native speakers.** Decide what waits for a person, by content type, by locale, or by a score threshold you set. Every correction tunes the localization engine, so the native speakers' edit rate falls over time.

**Who runs on it**

Lingo.dev is the standard localization infrastructure for modern enterprise teams scaling into new markets, including Mistral, Solana, SoSafe, and Cal.com. Teams have processed over 300M words on the platform, for their customers all over the world. Lingo.dev is SOC 2 Type II compliant, and has raised $4.2M from Y Combinator, Initialized Capital, and the founders of Supabase and Dependabot to scale the platform and meet the growing demand from international teams.

**Ask**

If you release into languages nobody on your team reads, we will score what goes live today, per language, on your own content.

Set up Lingo.dev: <https://lingo.dev>

Book a demo: <https://lingo.dev/enterprise>

And send this to the localization professional you know. Scoring quality in languages nobody on the team reads is their job, and this is where that work happens.

**Team**

[Veronica](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vrcprl/) and [Max](https://www.linkedin.com/in/maxprilutskiy/), [Lingo.dev](https://lingo.dev)'s founders, met eight years ago at work. Veronica has a data science and AI background. Max has an engineering background, having led a DORA-elite frontend team at Typeform, one of Europe's best-known SaaS products.

Both experienced localization problems firsthand while working at startups and enterprise companies and while bootstrapping a SaaS with customers from over 100 countries. This shared experience led them to create Lingo.dev, so the professionals accountable for translation quality can measure it in every language, including the ones nobody on the team reads.

launches.title: Karmen: The AI Assistant for Construction Project Managers
launches.tagline: Spend less time in your inbox.
launches.body:
### 

### **TL;DR**

Karmen is an **AI assistant** for **construction project managers**, helping them save time by automating admin tasks like **invoice approvals, RFI management,** and **change order tracking**. By linking directly to emails and texts, Karmen captures and organizes project updates, letting owners and general contractors automate time-consuming documentation tasks. Project managers can **save around 3 hours per day** from searching through 100s of emails and uploading to multiple construction management tools such as Procore.

### **The Problem: Project Managers Spend Hours on their Emails**

Construction project managers receive hundreds of emails daily, many from subcontractors. These emails often include:

* **Invoices**: Billing for completed work or materials.
* **RFIs (Requests for Information)**: Requests for clarification on project details or specifications.
* **Change Orders**: Requests for modifications that impact project scope, schedule, or cost.

Subcontractors often send emails or texts and are reluctant to adopt construction management software to submit these requests. As a result, project managers spend hours reading emails and entering data into platforms such as Procore.

### **The Solution: Automate these Tedious Tasks with AI**

Karmen lets project managers link their emails and construction management software (e.g. Procore) to do the following:

* **Data Entry**: Automating the manual process of entering details from correspondence, such as invoices.
* **Project Matching**: Match emails to the relevant project and subcontractor.
* **Real-time Updates**: Notify project managers of subcontractor updates that may affect the project schedule scope. i.e. a potential change order.

### **Demo**

<https://youtu.be/YtrQeMM5Yps>

### **About Us**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85372&key=user_uploads/2190507/ccc2d86b-7c9a-4c1e-9af4-00f660cc63c4)

Jonas managed logistics as a **commodity trader at IXM**. Also, growing up, he worked for his parents, who were general contractors in London.\
\
Naman built AI-powered construction software for companies like **Shell, ExxonMobil, and Suffolk** as a **software engineer at nPlan**. He also holds a Master’s Degree with a specialization in Machine Learning & Artificial Intelligence.

### **Asks**

If you (or someone you know) are a project manager, [book a demo](https://calendly.com/jonasebrahimi-karmenai) or reach out to [jonas@karmenai.com](https://jonas@karmenai.com) or [naman@karmenai.com](https://naman@karmenai.com).\
\
Thanks for reading!\
Co-founders at Karmen\
Jonas & Naman

launches.body:
Codebuff is a CLI-based coding agent – invoke it in your Terminal and ask it to write code for you. We launched on BookFace last week and got 500 downloads and 60+ upvotes!

It’s a Cursor alternative that’s simpler and frequently performs better. Try it out:

```
npm install -g codebuff
```

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84718&key=user_uploads/209148/c0fe87b7-bb51-47ac-9023-8cc38ede96cf)

### What people are saying

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84718&key=user_uploads/209148/6224e821-9d82-4620-b57f-d428c9af8ea0)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84718&key=user_uploads/209148/771297ed-0012-4601-a983-e416463f16fb)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84718&key=user_uploads/209148/86a6581c-ef41-490e-9a17-b36a5f73f629)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84718&key=user_uploads/209148/4c066ef1-ced0-4fc1-b5d4-a16a8ef7609c)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84718&key=user_uploads/209148/14872fde-79d4-4e53-8491-457e41f4ff5f)

### Fewer clicks, more codebase context

Codebuff is different from all the other coding agents, we swear!

* **It chooses files to read automatically on each message** — unlike Cursor’s composer feature. This saves you time and makes Codebuff respond more comprehensively.
* **It takes 0 clicks** — type your instructions and Codebuff will edit your files directly. It's simple and fast. Theoretically, you can do all your development by just chatting with it!
* **It has full access to your existing tools, scripts, and packages** — Codebuff can install packages, run terminal commands and tests, etc. Whatever awk/grep/pip install stuff you used to do, Codebuff can do it for you instead!
* **It is portable to _any_ development environment —** no lock-in here! Feel free to bring your IDE: VSCode, Cursor, Vim, Emacs, Replit, or plain text editor (if you’re a monster).
* **We don’t store your codebase** — we just pass individual files along to OpenAI and Anthropic as is necessary to generate code. We didn’t even have a database until a couple weeks ago!

Codebuff can write code for every tech stack – we know because we’ve built software from full-stack web apps to IoT device firmware.

<https://www.tella.tv/video/code-coding-agent-bh6l>

### Offer

To celebrate our launch, we are giving away **2,500 free Codebuff credits per month** for a limited time to new users!

To claim, 1. get Codebuff in your terminal:

```bash
npm install -g codebuff
```

2\. Run `codebuff` in your project directory.

3\. Finally, enter “login” to sign up and claim the 2,500 free credits.

Also, **existing users**: you can refer your friends at [codebuff.com/referrals](http://codebuff.com/referrals) — when you refer a friend, you’ll both get **500 credits per month**!

## 🙏 Ask

Try it out and give us feedback! Check out our website <https://codebuff.com>

If you have any thoughts, please join our Discord: <https://discord.gg/mcWTGjgTj3>. We love love love all feedback, positive and negative! Even slightly backhanded ones like this 😅:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84718&key=user_uploads/209148/b24d3c54-1d2c-4bca-8c2f-37a65f0fb8d1)

So please try Codebuff out and let us know what you think!

name: HYBRD
long_description:
The mission of HYBRD is to take world-class coaching and make it universally available. 

Health data has never been more abundant. GPS watches track pace and heart rate, wearables monitor sleep and recovery, and voice logging has made it easier than ever to capture weightlifting and HYROX. 

And yet most athletes are still following static PDF plans they found online, or "adaptive" apps that fall apart the moment cross-training enters the picture.

Existing tools feel disappointing because they don’t actually know your goals and constraints, so they can’t do anything meaningful with the data they collect. 
HYBRD can. 

We aggregate your wearable data, fill the gaps with a simple AI logger, and use that complete picture to build personalized training programs from the best coaches in the world, like Alex Viada, who coined the term "hybrid athlete." 

From there, the HYBRD agent keeps you on track, adjusting your schedule around weather, travel, and fatigue as you progress. Everything you'd get from a $500/month coach, at a 50x lower price. 

Founded in 2024 by WHOOP and AWS alumni, HYBRD is built by hybrid athletes. Join us for a workout every Monday morning in San Francisco and Boston.

launches.tagline: Connect wearables, understand training history, send plans to smartwatches
launches.body:
Lifters, runners, triathletes, cyclists: you can now turn your personal AI agent into a fitness coach with HYBRD. Once you connect to the HYBRD MCP, your AI agent will be able to: 

* Access and understand all your historical training data
* Use that data to make workouts and training plans
* Push those recommendations to your device (watch and/or phone) so you can execute the workouts

**To get set up, just paste this into Claude / Muse / Instinct:** 

set up <https://hybrd.com/resources/mcp-setup/skill.md> \
\
Millions of athletes already build training plans inside their favorite AI tool. But those tools have no access to wearable data, no memory from one session to the next, and no way to get a workout from the chat window onto an athlete's watch. HYBRD MCP closes that gap.

The first thing you should try with HYBRD MCP is to ask something like: 

* Across all my runs, when did I have the best ratio between grade adjusted pace and heart rate?
* What was my most consistent phase ever? 
* What was the difference between my Napa Marathon prep and Boston Marathon prep?

Then have it write you a training plan for your next goal: 

* Using the workouts I did most consistently, come up with a plan for Ironman California
* Help me ramp back up to what I used to lift while maintaining my running volume
* I’m traveling and will only have access to hotel gyms for a while, modify my current training plan

HYBRD will write those workouts back to your wearable and phone, so you just have to click “start” and you’ll get guided through the plan

You can also use our companion mobile app to make tracking lifting easy, or track your runs using your phone’s GPS if you don’t have a smartwatch. 

HYBRD will manage your wearables connection, be a system of record for your training plan / completed workouts, and steer LLMs towards giving better fitness coaching

The experience gets especially magical with tools like Muse or Instinct, which can proactively check the local weather, block off time on your calendar, order the right fueling for you etc. 

Sleep, recovery and nutrition data support are coming in the next few days. 

We have a few thousand athletes on HYBRD so far, check out what they’re doing with it below:

launches.tagline: get faster and stronger
launches.body:
Hey YC! We’re the team behind HYBRD - Ruiters, Shoe, Ben, Michael and Mats. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100595&key=user_uploads/1315661/b570d491-7243-4a3c-8660-ca425a646339)

We’re excited to share that today **HYBRD is becoming a coach in your pocket.** It’s like having a $500/month private coach on call 24/7. We provide a world-class training plan, then adapt it based on your life, progress, and recovery to keep you on track. 

\
[LINK TO DEMO VIDEO](https://youtube.com/shorts/PgPKkJqbYs0)

ASK: [TRY IT NOW ON THE APP STORE](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hybrd-get-faster-stronger/id6670271875)

\
**Introducing HYBRD Brain**

HYBRD Brain is our AI-powered coach built on top of HYBRD's structured training plans. Tell Brain about your schedule, sport mix, travel, or injuries — and it restructures your entire plan accordingly.

## **⭐ Why HYBRD is different**

These aren't ChatGPT-slop training plans.

We've partnered with Alex Viada (creator of the term "hybrid athlete") and his Complete Human Performance team to use their world-class programming as HYBRD's foundation. Our agent adapts those plans to you while preserving best-in-class athletic methodology.

(Alex also bought an iPhone just to use HYBRD)

**HYBRD Brain can coach you to achieve anything**

* Training for a marathon but also playing soccer twice a week? HYBRD Brain adjusts your running volume.
* Tweaked your Achilles and need to back off temporarily? HYBRD Brain rebuilds your training block.
* Traveling for work and missed three sessions? HYBRD Brain recalculates what comes next so you don’t lose momentum.

Instead of forcing you to follow a plan that breaks on contact with reality, HYBRD Brain builds a plan that adapts to you. 

**HYBRD actually does things**

Chatting with your health data is cool, but not useful. Most apps just regurgitate your charts back to you (you know how to read a graph) and recommend the CDC's 75 minutes of vigorous activity per week.

These tools feel disappointing because they don't know your actual goals and constraints, like upcoming races, equipment and your schedule, so they can't do anything meaningful with the data they collect.

HYBRD understands your goals and proactively proposes adjustments that fit your plan. Unplanned workouts, missed sessions, fatigue, cross-training, new PRs… HYBRD recognizes these moments and reorganizes your schedule around them.

**HYBRD uses ALL of your workout data**

Every workout you do is a puzzle piece in a broader picture of performance. But fitness tracking data is siloed across multiple domains. You might track your running data on a Garmin, your sleep/recovery on WHOOP and your strength training in a spreadsheet. 

It kinda works if you’re _just_ a runner or _just_ a lifter.

But more and more people are becoming “hybrid” athletes who focus on strength _and_ cardio, so they’re left stitching together multiple data sources to see the full picture.

Do it wrong and you risk “cardio killing your gains”

**HYBRD is adaptive to your history, current level and progress**

HYBRD integrates with all leading wearables and data sources, pulling in your full workout history and deduplicating it. From that data, we give you a holistic view of your strength and cardio fitness, normalized for age, gender, and weight, as a single score you can track over time.

Cycling, running, rowing, lifting: we interpret it all to model your physiology and personalize your plan.

Say you want to train more like Alex Viada. You probably aren't deadlifting 700lbs and logging 15+ hours a week (yet?). We scale the fundamentals of his programming down to exactly where you are now.

**FitBench**

Ok, it wouldn't be an AI launch without benchmarking.

We built **FitBench**, a benchmark that evaluates an AI coach across four dimensions: Scientific accuracy, athlete safety, recommendation actionability and conciseness across 25 common coaching scenarios. We used Opus 4.6 as an LLM-as-a-judge to score HYBRD Brain against current ChatGPT and its predecessors.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100595&key=user_uploads/1315661/c6e545d7-114b-4cc5-9e1f-806f7197e7d2)

But how does that compare with human coaches?

We had HYBRD sit for the **Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS)** exam, which is the gold standard in coaching. You need 70% to pass (half of all human test-takers don't make it). HYBRD scored 77%.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100595&key=user_uploads/1315661/4cfa2415-0d8f-4106-850b-f15fcf307d54)

\
**Our Story**

Ben, Mats, and Shoe all met while working on getting WHOOP to PMF. At the time, outside of work, Mats was training on the US national rowing team and Ben + Shoe were making their first forays into Ironman training.

We realized that fitness hardware was getting really good, but also was being commoditized. (Just take a look at Coros brutally undercutting Garmin prices)

For all the data being collected, existing products weren’t providing real coaching to multi-disciplinary “hybrid” athletes like us, partly because none were built to handle strength + cardio data, and partly because models weren’t good enough. 

Most athletes are still following static PDF plans they found online, or "adaptive" apps that fall apart the moment cross-training enters the picture.

We teamed up with our co-founder and CTO Ruiters (a senior AWS engineer at the time) and Michael (our founding engineer) to solve that with HYBRD. 

If that problem resonates with you, [try a 7 day free trial of HYBRD!](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hybrd-get-faster-stronger/id6670271875)

launches.title: HYBRD: Get faster & stronger
launches.tagline: World-class training plans personalized perfectly to you
launches.body:
**TLDR:** HYBRD (F24) is launching personalized strength + 5k/10k/half-marathon/marathon plans to make you faster and stronger! The training plans are by world-class coach Alex Viada, the guy who literally wrote the book that started the _hybrid athlete_ movement. We personalize his plans perfectly to you based on your data and preferences.

**You can check out a demo here:** https://youtube.com/shorts/WCzKPLmS_A4?feature=share

**Asks**

* Get ridiculously fit so that you live longer and show up as the best version of yourselves for your friends and families
* Do this by trying our 7 day free trial (find us on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hybrd-get-faster-stronger/id6670271875))
* Stay motivated by joining our free weekly workout clubs in San Francisco and Boston (email me at [mats@hybrd.app](mailto:mats@hybrd.app) to join the groupchat)
* Pay it forward by sharing HYBRD with the most athletic people you know

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/2636ea96-f4e3-4c5a-9fb9-03a49e4d7e30)

(pictured above is Alex Viada - if you’re not familiar, he wrote the first book on hybrid training and an inspiration to many, many coaches and athletes in this space. He bought an iPhone just to try HYBRD and we’ve since launched a partnership to provide his training plans on the platform)\
\
**Ok.. I want to be strong and fast, but what are you actually building?**

We break down the silos between your cardio, strength and wearable data to give you a complete view of your performance.

Then we use that data to personalize training plans from world-class coaches to you. We’re ex-WHOOP, ex-US national rowing team, triathletes / ultramarathoners ourselves and are building the training platform that we wish had existed for us.\
\
**Why do I need a separate app for this?**

Every workout you do is a puzzle piece in a broader picture of performance. But fitness tracking data is siloed across multiple domains. You might track your running data on a Garmin, your sleep/recovery on WHOOP and your strength training in a spreadsheet.

It kinda works if you’re _just_ a runner or _just_ a lifter.

But more and more people are becoming “hybrid” athletes who focus on strength _and_ cardio, so they’re left stitching together multiple data sources to see the full picture.

Do it wrong and you risk “cardio killing your gains”

**What are you guys doing about it?**

First, HYBRD integrates with all leading wearables and data sources. We pull in as much historical data as we can. We pull in your workouts and deduplicate them.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/ea007cfa-7a37-4fe1-ac3a-cf3766489e8f)

Then, we make it really easy to track your weightlifting, CrossFit, HYROX - things that aren’t well suited for tracking on a wearable.

You can use text to input your workout to our AI logger - or, simply upload a picture of your training journal, a whiteboard from a HYROX gym, or a screenshot from an app you already use.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/d7b6ae82-a69f-44ef-85de-eafad05467e6)

Based on that data, we provide a holistic view of your strength and cardio abilities, normalized for age/gender/weight and give you a single score (analogous to a chess Elo score) that you can use to track your progress.

Cycling, running, rowing, lifting data can all be interpreted and used to model your physiology.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/40a31bf9-1e3d-4cf3-98e1-f8b3ea2cd8a4)

That gives us all the information we need to know to personalize a training plan for you.

For example - lets say you want to be more like Alex Viada, the guy I mentioned above. You might not deadlift 700lb+ and be training 15+ hours a week (yet?), so we can scale down the fundamentals of his training plan to whatever is right for you:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/316c1a00-295f-4498-a9a7-52a70ed43a06)

These training plans have been developed by likely the most reputable coaching organization in hybrid athletics - Complete Human Performance (shout out to Alex as well as Trevor Tartaglia and Ariana Scalfo!)

And once you have that workout plan, we can push it directly to your Garmin (Coros + Apple Watch coming soon), so you can easily run through the workout on the go.

You’ll be motivated to keep making progress by pushing up your Training Score, which is the first metric to encapsulate both strength and cardio training load, developed by us and Anna Cruse, the Director of Applied Health and Performance Science at the University of Utah.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/c04f9964-96e3-457c-a1e5-b03c8fd2fc8c)

**Where is this all going?**

We’ve already had hundreds of thousands of workouts get processed when HYBRD was a tracking-only app, so we’re really pumped about taking things to the next level by adding in adaptive programming.

We’re going to keep adding more plan types (HYROX, triathlon coming soon) as well as more personalization levers (probably sleep + recovery etc.)

Right now we’re iOS only but stay tuned on the Android side.

**Who are you to tell me how to get stronger + faster..?**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/3a16ba00-2b5e-4607-bda2-b0152ec649a2)

**Well, we’ve got a great team!**

(from left to right)

* our CTO [**@Matt Ruiters**](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1833503) was a USA Rugby All-American and a former senior SWE at AWS

launches.title: HYBRD: the Performance Hub for Modern Athletes
launches.tagline: Sync cardio, strength and wearable data for a complete view of athletic performance
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

HYBRD is the performance hub for modern athletes. We break down the silos between your cardio, strength and wearable data to give you a complete view of your performance. We’re ex-WHOOP, ex-US national rowing team, triathletes / ultramarathoners and are building the app that we wish existed for us.

After a great invite-only beta with hundreds of paying users, **we’ve just launched publicly on the** [**iOS App Store**](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hybrd-hybrid-athlete-tracker/id6670271875)!

\
Full demo video here: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HOBtxG8r3m8>

**The problem** 

Every workout you do is a puzzle piece in a broader picture of performance. But fitness tracking data is siloed across multiple domains. You might track your running data on a Garmin, your sleep/recovery on WHOOP and your strength training in a spreadsheet. 

It works if you’re _just_ a runner or _just_ a lifter. 

But more and more people are becoming “hybrid” athletes who focus on strength _and_ cardio, so they’re left stitching together multiple data sources to see the full picture.

Until now. 

**Solution**

First, HYBRD integrates with all leading wearables and data sources. We pull in as much historical data as we can. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89832&key=user_uploads/1315661/1c56a0fe-5540-48db-9739-8d70739f7503)

Then, we make it really easy to track your weightlifting.

You can use text to input your workout to our AI logger - or, simply upload a picture of your training journal, a whiteboard from a HYROX/CrossFit gym, or a screenshot from an app you already use.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89832&key=user_uploads/1315661/649eacd0-e23e-4f46-8374-ae3e6a069399)

Based on that data, we provide a holistic view of your strength and cardio abilities, normalized for age/gender/weight and give you a single score (analogous to a chess Elo score) that you can compare with your training buddies.

\
We recently launched a trends feature so you can see all your data from all your data sources over time. And we’re working with one of the best coaches in the country to put together training plans for you (coming soon into the app) 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89832&key=user_uploads/1315661/fbb6c4d1-8d4d-48cb-a263-041ae6de0b43)

**Asks**

1. Try our 7 day free trial! \[[link to App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hybrd-hybrid-athlete-tracker/id6670271875)\]
2. Share our app with the most athletic people you know
3. Join our free weekly workout clubs in San Francisco and Boston (all welcome, contact us at [founders@hybrd.app](mailto:founders@hybrd.app), and let us know if you want a free Ironman 70.3 or marathon training plan)

**Team**

Three of our founders previously worked at WHOOP, each of us leading teams across product, growth and analytics. Our CTO, Matt, was a senior technical lead at Amazon AWS

We all are hybrid athletes ourselves - Mats was a member of the US national rowing team and Shoe, Ben and Ruiters have all completed Ironman 70.3s. 

Each of us felt underserved by existing fitness apps to the point where we tracked our workouts in Google Sheets, so we decided to build HYBRD.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89832&key=user_uploads/1315661/75a21bcd-311d-43cd-ba33-7451c9bdeb79)

Shoutout to the HYBRD Workout Club!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89832&key=user_uploads/1315661/e76b5fdc-8c51-4323-99c6-6b9365326cef)

What’s your HYBRD score?

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89832&key=user_uploads/1315661/0c7ed21b-29ab-41ba-adee-7279bfe249dc)

**The Solution:** BeerMe makes sending money fun and expressive.

name: Unusual
long_description:
AI agents are the newest audience brands need to speak to, but go-to-market teams don't have the tools to understand how they form opinions or make decisions.

Unusual helps brands in the Fortune 100 and scale-ups like Change.org and Astronomer drive more sales and win more market share by shifting how AI models perceive their offerings.

We work closely with every brand to (1) identify the root cause of AI misperception, (2) align on marketing, sales, and product strategies that appeal to agents, and (3) build infrastructure and content that makes their strongest proof more legible to agents.

Our methodology centers on applying black-box interpretability techniques to AI agents like ChatGPT and Claude to understand how they form opinions about a brand and its competitors. Seeing the *why* behind each opinion gives us the ability to create targeted interventions that change them.

launches.body:
Unusual creates and suggests media engineered to improve how AI talks about your brand – driving you more leads. This is the first “AI Relations” tool – public relations for AI models.

**The problem:**

Every day, your customers rely more on ChatGPT for their buying decisions. 

Getting tools like ChatGPT to send you leads is a lot more than GEO/AEO; it’s more like running a PR campaign – strategically building credibility and authority with models themselves.

**The solution:**

We built a platform that helps you improve AI’s holistic picture of your brand – what we’re calling “AI Relations.”

https://youtu.be/EIkyCu3kTt4 

We break this into three components, all of which Unusual manages:

1. Filling key knowledge gaps – publishing LLM-optimized content full of information LLMs are searching for, but don’t have: like a reference manual for your company. Check out ours here: https://llms.unusual.ai  
2. Getting you on the map – flagging the 3rd party media sources LLMs look to in your industry.
3. Nuanced reporting – analyzing how LLMs think about your company, and giving you extremely detailed reports on why they make the recommendations they do.

Unusual also track AI crawls of your content, so you can measure when it’s getting picked up and referenced by LLMs, helping you track ROI.

**Results:**

Quality wins fast with AI systems – content with rich and needed information is quickly picked up and referenced.

For [Parley](https://parley.so), an early customer, Unusual identified a key gap in what Perplexity knew about the space of SOC2 compliant AI for law firms. It automatically published pages to fill the gaps ([Model Use, Data Flows, and Isolation by Firm](https://ai.parley.so/model-use-data-flows-firm-isolation), [Encryption, Access Controls, and Audit Logging](https://ai.parley.so/encryption-access-controls-audit-logging)) and within a month, those two pages were within the top 3 most important citations for the topic area.

launches.title: 📬 Beglaubigt.de: Digital Business Address with AI Mailroom
launches.tagline: Now live: Company address for Hamburg, Berlin, and Munich in Germany
launches.body:
👋 Hey YC!

**Alex here — co-founder of Platus (F24)** and our German sub-brand [**Beglaubigt.de**](http://Beglaubigt.de), where we’re building the digital back-office for founders in Germany:

Today, we’re excited to share that we’re officially launching **legally-compliant business addresses + a fully digital, AI-driven mailbox** in **Hamburg, Berlin, and Munich in Germany**. This new service completes our core stack alongside digital incorporations and digital notarizations.

---

## 📬 **About Beglaubigt’s Address + Digital Mailroom**

In Germany, every founder needs a **_ladungsfähige Geschäftsadresse_** - a legally binding business address required for:

* Trade registrations
* Incorporations (UG/GmbH)
* Tax office communication
* Courts, authorities, and official notices
* Banking, payroll, insurance, vendors

Traditionally, this process is painfully analog: physical letters, misplaced notices, fake register scams, long delays, and hours lost walking to actual mailboxes.

**We turned the entire process into a digital, automated, AI-interpreted system.**

### **What you get**

* 🏢 **A legally compliant business address** (Hamburg, Berlin, Munich)
* 📨 **A fully digital mailbox** — every letter scanned and instantly available
* 🤖 **AI that reads, classifies & interprets every notice**
* 🔀 **Auto-routing to the right team member**
* 🚨 **Real-time fraud & fake-register detection**
* 📦 **Automatic physical forwarding when needed**
* 🔒 **Secure storage, searchable archive, full audit trail**

Your mailbox will never look the same again — 2025 is digital, fast, and AI-powered. See for yourself:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95836&key=user_uploads/1428849/a0650d56-775e-47e9-b144-7307245139b2)

---

## ⚡ **Why this matters**

Because the business address isn’t just an address — it’s the _nerve center_ of every German company. With this launch:

* We **unify** **incorporation + address + mail + workflow automation**
* We eliminate one of the most common operational breakpoints for early-stage companies
* And we bring real leverage into a system that was designed for paper, not speed

This product fits perfectly into our broader vision: making entrepreneurship in Germany radically simpler, faster, and fully digital.

---

## 🤝 **Why founders already love the shift**

**No more fear of “Did I miss an important letter?”**\
\*\*No more manual processes.\*\*\
No more slow loops.

And because once they see it, they say the same thing every time:

> Why did nobody build this earlier?

---

## 🚀 **What’s next**

---

More cities.\
Deeper automations.\
**An autonomous back office** that anticipates instead of reacts.

## 💬 **Want to try it?**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95836&key=user_uploads/1428849/aad178f1-110b-498c-b9be-4ef0c3ea1ad6)

Set up your business address in under 3 minutes.\
(And finally manage your German mail the way it _should_ work.)

👉 https://beglaubigt.de/geschaeftsadresse

If you’d like to learn more, ask a question, or see a demo — drop a comment, message us, or send an email to:\
[**alexandros@beglaubigt.de**](mailto:alex@beglaubigt.de)

launches.body:
Hey everyone, we're [Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexandersporenberg/) and [Felix](https://www.linkedin.com/in/felixgerlach/), the co-founders of [Platus (platus.com)](http://platus.com/).

# **TL;DR**

* **Legal infrastructure as no code and API**
* **First Notary-as-a-Service API**

Platus delivers fast, reliable legal solutions via a no-code platform and API, enabling SMEs with instant notarization, document drafting, e-signing, and workflow automation.\
\
<https://youtu.be/IlynObmr_sQ>

---

# **The Problem**

* **Legal services fail to meet today’s need for instant access**.
  * Just as Uber, DoorDash, and Revolut brought immediacy to mobility, food, and finance, legal services like drafting and notarization should be instantly accessible. In Germany, notarizations take hours at a notary’s office.
* **Legal operations are inefficient, turning simple tasks into lengthy processes.**
  * SMEs managing high-volume, time-intensive legal operations often lack the resources to automate their workflows.
* **Legal services are excessively costly, often only considered if absolutely unavoidable.**
  * In the U.S., legal help typically costs $200–$400 per hour, with complex cases exceeding $10,000, making it a last resort for SMEs.

# **Our Solution**

Platus provides instant legal infrastructure with essential tools to handle and automate legal tasks:

**1️⃣ Instant Online Notarization**: Notarize documents across different jurisdictions within 1-24hrs for documents such as Powers of Attorneys, Trust Certifications, and Apostilles.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85565&key=user_uploads/241802/42014a83-cde9-4f83-97e4-962c2aa14415)

**2️⃣ Notarization & e-Signatures via API**: Maintain full control of your customer relationships while enabling compliant document notarization and signing. Now with AI-powered signature field detection.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85565&key=user_uploads/241802/137aecb7-bc05-4bd5-85db-876298f73d1a)

**3️⃣ Automation with Workflows:** Choose from predefined playbooks or stack together your own workflow to automate internal or external legal processes.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85565&key=user_uploads/241802/42d11f19-4934-48e2-957c-a70f209bcd91)

**4️⃣ AI-Driven Document Intelligence**: Detailed insights from your company's legal documents.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85565&key=user_uploads/241802/c0a8b4e3-9b8e-47f3-84a5-a9eebd039b8a)

---

\
**Interested? Talk to us!**

1. [**Book a demo**](https://cal.com/fg/15min?date=2024-11-14&month=2024-11) and explore the platform in action.
2. **Custom Legal Workflows**? We can build customized solutions and workflows to your legal requirements.

Website: <https://platus.com/>\
LinkedIn: <https://linkedin.com/company/platus-inc>\
X: <https://x.com/platusai>

Reach out to us at [founders@platus.com](mailto:founders\*\*@platus.com), or [book a demo directly](https://cal.com/fg/15min?date=2024-11-14&month=2024-11).

Hey guys! We are Blake and JZ - co-founders of Cekura.

## ⏳TL;DR

Cekura built an AI browser agent that can read how-to articles and navigate the product to verify if the articles are still valid. It saves documentation/customer success teams at SaaS companies hundreds of hours per week.

<https://youtu.be/JJR7hz3dPaQ>

## 😱 Problem: Things Break When You Move Fast

The engineering team is releasing a new feature — hoorayyy! Guess who’s not excited — the documentation team. So many help articles are no longer up-to-date. They are now faced with 2 options:

1. Finding and reading through all the relevant product help articles (this will take literally 100+ hours of manual labor per week for some companies), or
2. Hoping that a dissatisfied customer will file a complaint instead of quietly churning.

## 🤩 Solution: AI Documentation Checker

Cekura’s browser agent will check if your documentation is up-to-date by following the instructions in your documentation like a real user! It can:

1. Set up proper sandbox environment (i.e. admin vs non-admin users)
2. Perform actions like a real person (reading the page, scrolling, clicking, etc)
3. Record session replays to show you exactly what was wrong with the documentation

Blake and JZ both graduated from Brown with a computer science degree this year. They worked on countless projects together, ranging from independent creative projects to a consumer startup with thousands of users (known by batchmates as the team that pivoted from making music videos to AI browser agents).

launches.body:
# **TL;DR**

At [Tiny](https://andtiny.com/) we’re building a compound startup like [Rippling](https://www.rippling.com/) for factories. Our mission is to provide factories with a single, cohesive platform to track and manage the full lifecycle of a manufactured item across every department in their organization.

<https://youtu.be/kmhj7bozMro>

We’re already working with several factories in Indonesia, Vietnam, and India, focusing on suppliers in the automotive and electronics industries.

# **The Problem**

Many factories are trapped in a web of disjointed spreadsheets and partially integrated tools, requiring costly manual data re-entry at nearly every stage—unless they can afford to spend over $1M on an ERP solution like SAP. This fragmentation leads to poor visibility into true costs and inventory, resulting in over-ordering of materials and dead stock of manufactured goods.

# **The Solution**

Tiny is a ground-up reimagination of cumbersome traditional ERP software. Factories now have an intuitive user experience that leverages live collaborative editing to get everyone working together seamlessly, with a workflow engine that assigns tasks to the right person at the right time. Furthermore, as we expand our platform, we plan to automate repetitive tasks, thereby reducing costs and unlocking valuable insights by unifying sales, procurement, and production processes—all within a single system.

Currently, we’ve started at the very beginning of the order lifecycle: the quotation process. Our first module empowers sales and engineering teams to respond to customer inquiries faster and more accurately. The foundation of this module—the workflow engine, the lightweight CRM, and the item library—are shared in the upcoming procurement and production modules, resulting in deep integration and a seamless experience for our customers.

The foundation we’ve built is a fully collaborative object graph with real-time computations, plus a truly novel form input framework including automatic object syncing and interactive audit logs, on top of durable workflow execution that enables us to customize workflows extremely efficiently. Thanks to this foundation, we are uniquely positioned to unlock never-before-seen, truly interactive collaboration with AI agents.

# **About Us**

We’re [Louis](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ldevalliere) and [Ed](https://www.linkedin.com/in/edward-zhang-14685828/), co-founders who have known each other for over a decade. We were roommates in San Francisco and previously collaborated at Addepar, developing wealth management software, and at Zenefits, building benefits and payroll solutions. Before founding Tiny, Louis served as VP of Design at BitGo, and Ed led the scaling of Apple’s Services API gateway from the ground up.

# **How You Can Help**

We’d love introductions to anyone connected with factories who might benefit from a more streamlined, cost-effective solution.

launches.title: Crustdata - Web Search API for AI Agents
launches.tagline: Fastest and most accurate web search API for people, companies and events
launches.body:
Hey everyone! 👋

We’re **Chris, Abhilash, and Manmohit** - founders of [**Crustdata**](https://crustdata.com) (YC F24). We’re restructuring the web for AI agents by building the **first search engine built specifically for AI agents** to find information on **people, companies, and events**.

This launch is our [**Web Search API**](https://crustdata.com/apis/websearch) - the fastest, most accurate way for agents to get **structured, fresh web data** they can actually act on.

🎥 Demo video 👇

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IouWW97hBN8>

## **TL;DR**

* 🧠 [**Web Search API**](https://crustdata.com/apis/websearch) for AI agents: real-time search + fetch → structured data mapped to a canonical entity
* 🧩 Proprietary indexing algorithm that **maps every relevant web document back to the correct person/company entity**
* 🏗 Built on **2 years of verified people + firmographic data APIs**, now extended to index the rest of the web
* 🔎 Pair it with our [**People Search API**](https://crustdata.com/apis/people-discovery) to find the right people, then pull the freshest context from the web

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97527&key=user_uploads/508558/e3f61603-9266-4b39-8714-3b48fb680d25)

## **Problem**

The web has _everything_ about people and companies - funding posts, blogs, GitHub, research papers, podcasts, job changes, pricing pages, news - but it’s:

* scattered across **billions of pages**
* written for **humans**
* hard for AI to **reliably connect** into one coherent view

So agents either:

1. scrape brittle HTML and break constantly, or
2. use stale databases and miss what changed this week.

## **Solution**

We spent **2 years** building **verified People + Company APIs**. That gave us high-confidence entity profiles.

Now we’re indexing the **rest of the web** and building a proprietary indexing algorithm that:

1. finds every relevant document about a person/company
2. **maps it to the right entity**
3. returns it as **structured data** that agents can use immediately

That’s the foundation of [**Crustdata Web Search API**](https://crustdata.com/apis/websearch).

Think: **a search engine for agents**, where the output isn’t “10 blue links,” but **entity-linked, structured, fresh context from the web**.

---

## **What you can build with it**

### **AI SDR / GTM agents**

* Get the **latest** proof points on a company (launches, funding, exec moves, pricing changes)
* Generate personalization that’s actually timely

### **Recruiting / sourcing agents**

* Identify candidates with the right background using [**People Search API**](https://crustdata.com/apis/people-discovery)
* Pull the newest context (papers, talks, open source projects, blog posts, news, events) via [**Web Search API**](https://crustdata.com/apis/websearch)

### **Research / diligence agents**

* Track a market/category and continuously attach new web documents to the right companies/people
* Turn web noise into structured signals

---

## **Our ask**

If you’re building an **AI agent** or **GTM tool** and need **real-time people + company data from the web**, check out [**Crustdata**](https://crustdata.com).

* Docs / access: [**Web Search API**](https://crustdata.com/apis/websearch)
* People discovery: [**People Search API**](https://crustdata.com/apis/people-discovery)
* Book a demo: <https://crustdata.com/demo>

**TL;DR**

We’re building Crustdata which provides live company and people data via APIs and webhooks. We let you watch, enrich, or search for any person or company on LinkedIn - and get updates in real-time.

**🚩 Problem**

Getting fresh, reliable, accurate B2B data at scale is hard.

In 2024, data needs to be live and pinpoint accurate, but most data platforms source from unreliable, poorly maintained 3rd party sources. And the data isn’t updated frequently — monthly, if you’re lucky.

Any company trying to add an intelligence layer to their system or process needs data.

Problem: it’s an incredible technology challenge to do that at scale.

**✅ Solution**

We have developed technology that allows us to index and pipe in live data from almost any data source. Currently, we do this at scale from sources including LinkedIn, the SEC, funding announcements and milestones, employee ratings, product reviews, web traffic -  and deliver this data instantly to our customers.

Our technology also enables you to ‘watch’ companies and people on a live basis. Get monthly, weekly, daily, hourly, or instant updates when a predefined event happens.

Events like:

\- Company grows or declines in headcount

\- Company grows in headcount by certain role

\- Company grows in certain headcount in specific regions

\- Company hires for specific technologies or titles in specific regions

\- Company lists a job posting for a certain title or technology

\- Company announces or closes funding round

\- Company gets a new product review

\- Person changes jobs

\- Person gets a promotion

\- Person adds a new skill

\- Company or Person makes a LinkedIn post

▶️ **Demo**

<https://youtu.be/TwUYDCrdLvk>

**🕰️ Why now**

Clean, fresh, and accurate data is becoming increasingly important. The age of AI is producing whole new product lines and allowing companies to make their sales process smart.

There are AI SDR companies that are totally reliant on fresh, primary source data to run their whole process.

B2B sales teams are depending on appropriate triggers to make sure they are reaching out to the right person at the right time.

Customer success teams need to track key personnel at their customers, in real-time.

Growth equity investors are shifting towards in-house data stacks and models to do their entire deal sourcing.

Early stage startups need a data-driven approach in GTM research to identify the right market they can plant their wedge in.

**🧑🏽‍🤝‍🧑🏻 Team**

We have a decade plus experience building our own separate VC-backed data products. We have spent an inordinate amount of time on the problem which has allowed us to have a unique insight and experience that is tough to replicate.

The majority of knowledge work in future will be done by AI agents. Our goal is to wield the web as the data warehouse for the AI agents of the future, starting with people and company data.
